data.name: Tempest of Nations
data.detailed_description:
Tempest of Nations is a real-time, historical grand strategy game set during the Industrial Revolution. Lead your nation through one of the most transformative eras of history as you manage diplomacy, economics, and politics.

GAMEPLAY

  • Choose to play as any one of the dozens of nations that existed at the start of the 19th century.

  • Grow your economy by expanding industry, exploiting natural resources, and balancing trade.

  • Research technology to give you an edge over your rivals. 

  • Influence internal politics to ensure stability, pass reforms, and appease opposing political interests.

  • Use diplomacy to forge alliances, negotiate treaties, and maintain the balance of power—or strive to do away with it entirely.

  • Engage in warfare across the world, ordering your armies to achieve war aims or by manually taking charge.

  • Expand your nation outward through conquest and colonization, or choose to focus on developing what you already have. All playstyles are feasible.

FEATURES

  • A highly detailed map of the world with thousands of pieces of land that can be individually conquered or administered

  • A historical starting scenario where each country feels different based on the unique circumstances it finds itself in

  • Detailed population units with their own cultures, religions, languages, and professions

  • Over 30 distinct map modes, including population density, religion, diplomatic relations, resource distribution, and more

  • A built-in editor for creating custom scenarios or start dates, adding new countries or populations, and editing the map
